      Meet the Executive

      The University of Western Australia has an Executive team of academics and professional staff members.


      The following officers comprise the Executive:

      Vice-Chancellor

      Professor Amit Chakma

      DipIng IAP (1982), MASc PhD UBC (1987), DEng (Hon) Waterloo (2011), DSc (Hon) Dhaka (2017), PEng, ICD.D

      Senior Deputy Vice-Chancellor

      Professor Tim Colmer

      BSc (Agric)W.Aust., PhD Calif.

      Deputy Vice-Chancellor (Research)

      Professor Anna Nowak

      MBBS W.Aust., MLdship Deakin, PhD W.Aust., FRACP, GAICD

      Deputy Vice-Chancellor (Operations)

      Ms Selina Torrance

      Deputy Vice-Chancellor (Education and Student Experience)

      Professor Guy Littlefair

      Deputy Vice-Chancellor (Planning and Strategic Initiatives) and Chief Financial Officer

      Ms Leona Marquand

      BA(Hons) UOP, DipIFR ACCA, GradDipAppFin FASEA, ACA

      Deputy Vice-Chancellor (Global Engagement)

      Professor Jennifer Howell

      B.Ed (Sec) Griffith., BA (Lit) Griffith., M.Ed (TESOL) QUT., M.Ed (ICT) QUT., GC (Ed. Mngt) Leicester., PhD QUT., GAICD

      Deputy Vice-Chancellor (Indigenous)

      Professor Jill Milroy
